message:
Hi Everyone,

Just an update, today at 1o'clock in Baltimore there will be a community forum with the Maryland Secretary of DOC and the Commissioner. I will ask them to consider reducing the cost of calls that we pay. Part of our increased cost has to do with security. The so called security does not work. I was disconnected for them having detected 3-way calling on my line. That is a lie because I do not have that feature.

The issue of Securus, at this time Evercom the other part of Correctional Billing Service is under investigation by the state of Alaska brought on by the public utility staffers themselves for blocking calls to families in a certain area because the local phone company does not have an agreement with Evercom.

Also the other issue is that Securus does not have to right to be operating under Evercom filed tariff with the public utility commissions because it is only a holding company and not a telecommunicaton company.

T-Netix, Evercom and Securus days are numbered.
